dedupe_keys.name: a dataset of traget cement plants between 2012 and 2022 using improved yolov5 ieg model in china version2

description: This Chinese cement-plant dataset was assembled from remote-sensing detection and other sources. Zenodo lists one open RAR archive under CC BY 4.0. The provider describes 953 plant records with locations or areas and 23 attributes, including production-status information reconstructed from 2012–2022 ACF products, point-of-interest data and company records. Such an inventory can help locate cement energy demand, process emissions or supply nodes in national industrial simulations. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this version 2 plant list. A limitation is that automated visual detection and company linkage may include omissions, geolocation error and stale plant status. The public page does not enumerate all fields, plant capacity units, validation sample or coverage of small facilities. Rights in upstream imagery and company data may differ from the Zenodo licence claim. The RAR archive was not downloaded or opened, and neither the count nor production-status classification was independently checked.
